definition.script:
pipeline { agent any
stages { stage('Backup Jenkins config to git') { steps { withCredentials([sshUserPrivateKey( credentialsId: 'bdc-etl-jenkins-push', keyFileVariable: 'SSH_KEY', usernameVariable: 'SSH_USER' )]) { sh '''#!/usr/bin/env bash set -euo pipefail
# --- known_hosts (strict) --- install -d -m 700 "$HOME/.ssh" ssh-keyscan -t ed25519 github.com >> "$HOME/.ssh/known_hosts" 2>/dev/null chmod 600 "$HOME/.ssh/known_hosts"
# Make sure key path is available to child processes export SSH_KEY SSH_USER
# --- Git SSH wrapper (safe for spaces in $SSH_KEY) --- cat > git_ssh_wrapper.sh <<'EOF' #!/bin/sh exec ssh -i "$SSH_KEY" \ -o IdentitiesOnly=yes \ -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes \ -o UserKnownHostsFile="$HOME/.ssh/known_hosts" \ "$@" EOF chmod 700 git_ssh_wrapper.sh export GIT_SSH="$PWD/git_ssh_wrapper.sh"
rm -rf repo git clone git@github.com:hms-dbmi/avillachlab-jenkins-bdc-etl.git repo cd repo
git checkout -B jenkins-backup-nightly git config user.name "jenkins" git config user.email "jenkins@hms-dbmi.local"
cd jenkins-docker rm -rf jobs jobs_old var
find "${JENKINS_HOME}/jobs" -name "config.xml" -exec cp --parents {} . \\; mv ".${JENKINS_HOME}/jobs" ./jobs
cp "${JENKINS_HOME}/config.xml" . cp "${JENKINS_HOME}/plugins.txt" . cp "${JENKINS_HOME}/scriptApproval.xml" .
git add -A git commit -m "Git push from Jenkins. Branch from jenkins-backup-nightly" || echo "No changes to commit" git push -u origin jenkins-backup-nightly ''' } } } } }
